description: Added 2026-09-03, REPLACING .github/dependabot.yml, which was retired in the same
commit. Two update bots on one repository open competing branches for the same
upgrade, and the resulting noise is what teaches people to stop reading dependency
PRs -- which costs more than either bot buys.
WHY RENOVATE AND NOT DEPENDABOT. Dependabot here covered `github-actions` ALONE.
This repository also carries a real npm tree under Extension/Full_Screen_Shot/test/e2e
(package.json + package-lock.json) that NOTHING was updating. Renovate manages both
ecosystems from one config, and the sibling repository already runs it, so there is one
tool and one dashboard across the pipeline instead of two of each.
🔴 AND IT IS WHAT MAKES THE PINNING SUSTAINABLE. 32 actions in this tree are pinned to
full commit SHAs (2026-09-02, after research/76 §D recorded 76 of 77 tags on one popular
action being force-pushed to an infostealer in March 2026). Every pin STOPS RECEIVING
SECURITY FIXES the moment it is applied. `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests` is the half
that keeps them current -- without it the pins rot and this tree ends up LESS safe than
before they were added.
⚠️ Renovate runs here from the SIBLING repository: Nikatru_Platform_Public's
.github/workflows/renovate.yml names both repos in RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES. There is no
workflow in THIS repo and there should not be a second one -- one schedule, one token,
one place to look when it stops. This file decides WHAT changes here; that workflow
decides WHEN and WHERE Renovate runs.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly window entirely, the same posture as the sibling repository.
